rules.condition: The installed Help1800 text is treated as January 2018 rate guidance.

rules.condition: compute18 or computeTotalAmtPayable is invoked.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: compute18 calls computeTotalAmtPayable, which calls compute18 again with no termination condition, causing unbounded mutual recursion.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Evaluate the dependency graph once in topological order.

rules.condition: Cumulative net gifts are below the fixed 250,000 exemption.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: The official formula subtracts 250,000 without clamping to zero, so downstream tax can become negative.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Clamp taxable net gifts at zero unless authoritative law explicitly permits a negative base.
